title: Sequencing: data import
bodyMd:
Five datasets are imported into a system, one at a time. Each import is completed once.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Accounts, Branches, Customers, Orders, Products.

- Products must be in position 2.
- Accounts must precede Orders.
- Branches and Customers must not occupy consecutive positions.
- Orders must not be in position 5.
